name: krea
description: Intent-first Krea workflows for image/video generation, architectural visualization, marketing creative, enhancement, LoRA training, and developer integration patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and videos with Krea through intent-first workflow prefabs.
interface.longDescription: Krea AI Skills turn your agent into a Krea-native creative collaborator. krea-ai is now the canonical intent-first router for image, video, enhancement, LoRA, product, campaign, and archviz workflows. krea-marketing and krea-archviz remain as redirect stubs for compatibility, while krea-build helps developers integrate Krea into their own applications.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a cyberpunk cat at golden hour
Render this Sketchup screenshot in photoreal evening light
Create a hero product shot of my new perfume bottle for the homepage
Help me integrate Krea image generation into my SvelteKit app
